name: Farmhouse Style Furniture - Custom Furniture & Kitchen Cabinets | White Bear Lake
old_description: At our core, we have a simple mission: to create handcrafted furniture that is both desirable and affordable. We understand the frustration of searching endlessly for the perfect piece, only to find it either out of reach financially or needing more quality. That’s why we have made it our goal to redefine the concept of “affordable furniture” by offering timeless, unique, and durable pieces made from solid wood. Our commitment extends beyond simply providing furniture. We deeply care about our community and have identified a genuine need for high-quality furniture at an accessible price point. By doing so, we aim to bring the beauty and craftsmanship of our pieces to a broader audience within our community and beyond.
about: Farmhouse Style Furniture operates from White Bear Township, Minnesota. The business traces its start to 2012 when James Putnam built a dining table for a friend, sparking demand for his woodworking. By 2017 Putnam left his previous job to pursue the craft full time, and the company now runs under the Putnam Farmhouse Furniture brand with a small team that includes Nathan Glenz and Trevor Putnam.
built_on: Custom design collaboration process from concept to installation
Handcrafted joinery using dovetail, mortise-and-tenon, and tongue-and-groove techniques
Solid-wood construction with species including oak, cherry, maple, and walnut
Finish process covering sanding, staining, and sealing for durability
type_evidence: Our highly skilled craftsmen meticulously design and handcraft each piece, tailored to your preferences.
